title: Editorial title
prompt: Title slide for a talk called "Decks that move." Editorial: one huge serif in soft pink on deep forest green. Stack the three words and bring them in one at a time. Put a small badge with rotating text in the corner. The only other text is the date.

title: Photo-led content
prompt: Explain how it works in one slide. Warm, photo-led editorial. On the left, an arched window with slow light moving through blinds. Serif headline with one italic line, one short sentence, then three numbered steps that rise in one by one.

title: Kinetic poster
prompt: Opener with poster energy. Rotated color blocks in yellow, hot pink, cobalt and black. Heavy condensed caps. Everything slams in fast, one piece at a time. The star spins last.

title: Big number
prompt: One data slide. Weekly decks shipped: 12, 14, 15, 19, 22, 27, 31, 38. Swiss style: off-white, black, one signal red for the last week. Bars rise one by one, then the multiple lands. Native and editable. No chart image.
motion: 8 bars rise from the baseline, one by one

title: Panorama timeline
prompt: Three-stop timeline: 1987, PowerPoint 1.0. 2007, presentations in Google Docs. 2026, slides that move. One line runs across all three slides, so each push transition reads as a camera pan. Clay and bone. A soft serif for the years. End on a pulsing dot.
motion: Dot zoom, year fly-in, caption fade

title: Orbit hero
prompt: Closing slide. A full-bleed orbit system turns slowly on warm black: pink rings, pink and cream planets, offset to the right. Two native lines over it: "Rendered once." and, in pink italic, "Plays forever."
motion: Native text fades in on top
